config.purpose: locate the n/d transition in the direction of the covariance effect, at n/d = 1.51 and n/d = 1.00
config.seed_rule: dataset i of a cell uses seed_base + 1000*i + cell_offset; its draws use that + 7919, shared by all six tests
config.pairing: the four arms see identical datasets and identical draw seeds
config.population_covariance: Q diag(c) Q.T, c_j = E[lambda_j z_j^2 / sum_k lambda_k z_k^2] by quadrature; sum(c) = 1 exactly, asserted to ten decimals
config.verification: a cell with any C-only rejection is re-run at three further seed bases and every discordance in either mode re-tested at 2000 draws; a cell with none records triggered=false, which is the protocol behaving correctly rather than a missing result
config.shift_classification: positive, negative, or indeterminate where |shift| < 0.03 ambient null sd
config.protocol_source: analysis/popcov_control.py and analysis/popcov_control_pr9.py, imported; only the per-cell conditioning differs
config.screening_provenance: cells 5 and 6 were screened in results/popcov_control_pr9_screen.json and its ladder; cell 7 in results/popcov_control_cells567_screen.json. Every screen is a prefix of the cell it screens, on the same offset and seed rule
